questions.question: What percentage of uninsured women aged 40 to 64 reported having a mammogram within the past 2 years in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2019'][0]

uninsured_val = None
for r in range(len(df)):
    if str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip() == 'Uninsured':
        uninsured_val = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])
        break

result = uninsured_val

questions.question: Among women aged 40 and over by poverty level, which two income categories had the highest mammography screening rates in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2019'][0]

poverty_rates = {}
for r in range(55, 59):
    cat = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    poverty_rates[cat] = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])

sorted_cats = sorted(poverty_rates, key=poverty_rates.get, reverse=True)
result = sorted_cats[:2]

questions.question: In 2018, by how many percentage points did the mammography rate for women aged 40–64 with private health insurance exceed that of uninsured women in the same age group?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2018 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2018'][0]

private_rate = None
uninsured_rate = None
for r in range(75, 81):
    cell = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    if cell == 'Private':
        private_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2018])
    elif cell == 'Uninsured':
        uninsured_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2018])

result = round(private_rate - uninsured_rate, 1)
